method.selection: First four clips from each previously frozen AMI and Svarah manifest, selected before Meet output; warm-up captures excluded.
method.references: Frozen publisher transcripts; no independent human listening review in this run.
method.transport: Two real Chromium participants; fixed WAV microphone injection -> WebRTC/Opus -> native SFU decoded per-speaker PCM -> VAD -> persistent recorder storage -> authenticated shared GPU worker -> private Drive.
method.silence: Two six-second digital-silence microphone playbacks with outbound RTP growth checked.
method.overlap: One AMI/Svarah pair played concurrently, second speaker starting 0.5 seconds later.
method.scoring: Concatenate completed segments chronologically for each known speaker and compare to that clip reference. Micro-aggregate word edit distance; no model-specific cleanup.
method.strict_policy: Case-fold and remove non-word/non-whitespace punctuation except apostrophes, then split on whitespace.
method.reference_policy: References were frozen before this browser run and retained unchanged; they were not independently listen-checked in this run.

names.coverage: One proper name; insufficient representative name/domain vocabulary coverage.

numbers.reason: No dates, amounts, or identifiers in the eight reference clips.

missing_speech.note: Two conjunctions omitted in one Indian-English clip; cause not isolated.

speaker_attribution.scope: Known separate participant microphone tracks, not diarization of mixed audio.

hallucinations.review: No invented sentence observed in the eight clips; substitutions remain included in WER. Not a long-silence/noise evaluation.

delivery.email: Deferred: isolated test site has no default outgoing Email Account. No SMTP delivery tested; pending notification flags retained.

remaining_gates: Representative longer authorized Meet recordings with independently checked human references, domain names, numbers, noise and degraded audio.
Indian-English subset scored 13.46% normalized WER; expand evaluation and review improvement before model acceptance.
One combined video recovered from an ffmpeg interruption and published Partial with an approximately 0.83-second gap; root cause was not established.
End-to-end outgoing email delivery requires a configured test sender.
Sustained multi-site load, fairness under backlog and live-caption latency isolation are not established by this short single-site run.
Forced crash exercised pending-job persistence before worker readiness, not a mid-inference GPU crash.
privacy: Raw audio, references, predictions, credentials and artifact identifiers remain outside git in private pilot storage; this report contains aggregate evidence only.
